body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 4 units. Until your next turn, enemies cannot make Reactions caused solely by that ally's movement.

surges.html: The target cannot make Reactions against you until the end of this turn.
Draw, conceal, place, or interact with one small carried or unattended item as part of this Action.

rider.title: DIVERSION CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: An enemy targets the chosen ally. Effect: The ally gains +1 Defense against that Action.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
